aiNotice.title: How we use AI
aiNotice.description: How MUDHOTECH HR RECRUITING SYSTEM uses AI to help employers review applications, what it never does, and your choices.
aiNotice.intro: Employers using this service may switch on AI-assisted screening. AI helps their recruiters find evidence in what you send. People make every decision about your application.

does.title: What the AI does
items: Reads your CV and answers and finds evidence for each requirement the employer published, such as a skill, qualification or years of experience.
Links every finding to where it came from (for example a page and line in your CV), so a person can check it.
Marks requirements it could not find as unknown. Missing information is never treated as a failure.
Suggests which applications look strongest against the published requirements, labelled as an AI-assisted suggestion that needs human review.

never.title: What the AI never does
items: It never shortlists, turns down, makes offers to or hires anyone. Only an authorised person at the employer can do that, and they must record a reason.
It never uses or guesses your age, gender, ethnicity or tribe, religion, marital status, pregnancy, health or HIV status, disability, politics or appearance.
It never penalises career breaks or the layout of your CV.
It never follows instructions written inside a CV or document.
It never runs while the employer or MudhoTech has switched AI off. Applications are then reviewed by people only, and nothing you sent is lost.

choices.title: Your choices
items: You can ask for a fully manual review when you apply. Reviewers will then not see an AI assessment of your application.
You can see and correct the information taken from your CV before you submit.
You can ask the employer to explain how your application was assessed.
You can ask to see, correct or delete your data at any time from your account.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Your application is shared only with the employer you apply to and used only for that vacancy, unless you agree to more. We handle personal data in line with the Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] of Zimbabwe. AI processing runs on our own systems by default; if an employer enables an external AI provider, your contact details are removed before anything is sent.

privacyNotice.title: Privacy notice
privacyNotice.description: How MUDHOTECH HR RECRUITING SYSTEM collects, uses, keeps and deletes personal data, and your rights.
privacyNotice.updated: Last updated 17 November 2026 · draft pending legal review
privacyNotice.intro: This notice explains how MudhoTech Solutions (Pvt) Ltd handles personal data in MUDHOTECH HR RECRUITING SYSTEM. Each employer also shows its own privacy notice when you apply.

sections.title: Who is responsible
items: The employer you apply to is responsible (the data controller) for your application and decides how it is assessed.
MudhoTech processes applications on the employer's behalf, and is responsible for your account, sign-in and security records.
We follow the Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] of Zimbabwe.

sections.title: What we collect
items: Your account details: name, email address, phone number and town.
What you send with an application: CV and documents, answers to the employer's questions.
Information the system finds in your CV, linked to where it came from so people can check it.
Security records such as sign-in times and shortened IP addresses.
We never ask for your date of birth, ID number, gender, marital status, religion, ethnicity or tribe, health or HIV status, disability, politics or a photo.

sections.title: How we use it
items: To send your application to the employer you chose, and only for that vacancy unless you agree otherwise.
To help the employer's recruiters find evidence in your application. People make every decision; see How we use AI.
To send you updates about your applications and keep your account secure.
We never sell your data or use it to train AI models.

sections.title: How long we keep it
items: Applications that did not lead to a job are anonymised after the employer's retention period (12 months after the vacancy closes unless the employer sets otherwise).
If an employer closes its account, its vacancies close, you are told, and your data is kept only until the same retention period ends.
Data may be kept longer only when the law requires it, for example during a legal dispute.
Backups are encrypted and expire automatically within 35 days, so deleted data disappears from backups within 35 days of deletion.

sections.title: Your rights
items: See and download your data, correct it, or ask for it to be deleted, from Privacy in your account.
Ask for a fully manual review of an application, with no AI assessment.
Withdraw consent you gave for optional uses, such as being considered for future vacancies.
We answer requests within 30 days. You can also complain to the Data Protection Authority (POTRAZ).

sections.title: Security and where data is stored
items: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, files are virus-checked, and every view of candidate data is logged.
Our servers are in South Africa (Amazon Web Services, Cape Town region).
MudhoTech staff can see an employer's data only with approved, time-limited, read-only access that the employer can see.

termsPage.title: Terms of use
termsPage.description: Terms for using MUDHOTECH HR RECRUITING SYSTEM.
termsPage.intro: These terms are being finalised with our legal advisers. Until then, the points below describe how the service works.

sections.title: Using the service
items: Job seekers can create an account, apply for vacancies and manage their data free of charge.
Employers use the service under a written subscription and data processing agreement with MudhoTech Solutions (Pvt) Ltd.
Do not upload anything you do not have the right to share, or files that contain malware.

sections.title: Decisions about applications
items: Employers make every decision about applications. AI only helps them find evidence and is labelled as an AI-assisted suggestion.
Vacancies are published by verified employers; report a suspicious vacancy to support.

sections.title: Contact
items: MudhoTech Solutions (Pvt) Ltd, Harare, Zimbabwe. Use the support address shown in your account or in our emails.

accessibilityStatement.title: Accessibility statement
accessibilityStatement.description: How accessible MUDHOTECH HR RECRUITING SYSTEM is and how to tell us about problems.
accessibilityStatement.intro: We want everyone to be able to find vacancies, apply and manage their applications, including people who use a keyboard, a screen reader or zoom.

sections.title: Our target
items: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA.
Every release is checked automatically for accessibility problems, and pages work with a keyboard alone.
Pages work on small screens and slow connections, and respect a reduced-motion setting.

sections.title: Known limitations
items: Original PDF files shown inside the review screen are images of the pages; the extracted text is always available as an alternative.
A full screen-reader review is planned before general availability.

sections.title: Tell us about a problem
items: If something does not work for you, contact support with the page address and what happened. We reply within 5 working days and can accept your application another way if needed.
